strapiBlog.title: Therme Dubai: The $545 Million Wellness Resort in the Heart of the City
strapiBlog.short_description: Dubai is about to unveil a wellness wonder unlike any other—the Therme Dubai development.

data.text:
Dubai is about to unveil a wellness wonder unlike any other—the Therme Dubai development. The architectural marvel within Zabeel Park is set to become the world’s tallest wellness building.

A cornerstone of the Dubai Quality of Life Strategy 2033, it redefines urban retreats by seamlessly blending innovation with sustainability. Explore Therme Dubai, a 500,000-square-foot wellness marvel making waves worldwide.

“Islands in the Sky” to Transform Dubai’s Skyline

Designed to stand at an impressive height of 100 meters (328 feet), Therme Dubai will integrate cutting-edge wellness experiences with a focus on environmental sustainability. 

His Highness Sheikh Hamdan bin Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum, Crown Prince of Dubai, Deputy Prime Minister, Minister of Defence, and Chairman of The Executive Council of Dubai, has unveiled plans for this ambitious $545 million (AED 2 billion) project.

Scheduled for completion in 2028, the development is expected to welcome 1.7 million visitors annually. Therme Group, the master developer in Dubai behind this project, has been at the forefront of wellness innovation worldwide. Known for its holistic approach to wellbeing, Therme Group has successfully executed similar projects across Europe and North America.

data.text:
Therme Dubai Location

Designed by Diller Scofidio + Renfro (DS+R), the structure will sit in the city’s Zabeel Park, beside the Royal Palace. This central position in the Zabeel district of Dubai, ensures that residents and tourists can easily access world-class wellness services within a 20-minute reach, aligning with the city's vision of a pedestrian- and environment-friendly urban lifestyle.

Therme Dubai Features and Facilities

The Therme Dubai wellness resort will house the world’s largest indoor botanical garden and various other amenities. The Islands in the Sky will feature three distinct zones:

  • Restoring: A dedicated space for hydrotherapy, thermal baths, and personalized spa treatments.
  • Relaxing: Serene botanical gardens, tranquil meditation spaces, and sensory wellness rooms.
  • Playing: Interactive water parks, leisure pools, and immersive VR relaxation experiences.

The integration of smart wellness technologies, AI-driven relaxation programs, and eco-friendly sustainability measures at Therme Dubai will set new benchmarks in the global wellness industry.

data.answer: The highly anticipated Therme Dubai opening date is set for 2028, with construction already underway.

faqs.question: What is the significance of Therme Dubai in the wellness industry?

data.answer: Therme Dubai is set to be the world’s tallest wellness building, offering an unmatched blend of relaxation, environmental sustainability, and high-tech wellness solutions.

faqs.question: Where will Therme Dubai be located?

data.answer: The wellness resort will be situated in Zabeel Park, ensuring easy access for both residents and tourists.

faqs.question: What are the key features of Therme Dubai?

data.answer: Therme Dubai features a mix of hydrotherapy, spa treatments, botanical gardens, interactive parks, and relaxation zones, all housed within a futuristic architectural setting.

faqs.question: Who is behind the Therme Dubai project?

data.answer: Therme Group Dubai, a leading global wellness innovator, is spearheading the development of this extraordinary project.
